column1: # Phase 13, tail 2 -- the words no earlier map carried, found by widening the
# sweep once everything else was done. Mostly the AST-walking tools, which
# talk about `nodo`, `arbol` and `fallos` on every other line.
# them is an argparse dest tied to a Spanish flag, or reads one.
# `PAQUETE` carries `str`: the architecture test patches it BY NAME.
# `modulo` carries `code`: the literal is a LABEL the submission test passes
# to its subprocess to say which load mode it wants, not a name.
